trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: The latest deploy of checkout-api (v2.3.1) was failing health checks in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
2. **Rolled back to v2.3.0** (the most recent release healthy in production). The first rollback attempt partially failed due to an orchestrator error that halted the rollout after us-east — a retry completed the rollout successfully.
3. **Verified recovery**: checkout-api is now healthy on v2.3.0 in all three regions, with the error rate down to 0.2%.
4. **Opened incident INC-0002** (SEV2) documenting the failure and rollback; the on-call engineer was paged.

Recommendation: hold v2.3.1 from redeployment until root cause of the health check failures is identified.
